subject: Observability commencement action plan — runbooks, alerts, and tracing
messages:
From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@northbridge.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>; Platform Ops <ops@northbridge.io>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Observability kickoff — constraints and desired outcomes

Hi Irene (and Redwood team),

Thanks for agreeing to run the observability implementation with us. Quick context: Northbridge is preparing for a phased rollout of our payment fraud detection service in Q1; we need traces, dashboards, and alerting in place for the initial canary and the GA launch. Primary goals for the kickoff:

- Validate tracing hooks for cross-service flows (ingest -> scorer -> policy engine).
- Build a lightweight dashboard for error rates and tail latencies.
- Define error taxonomy so our oncall can triage within 5 minutes.
- Agree alert routing and runbook triggers (who gets P0/P1/P2).

Constraints: we are on GCP us-west1 and need sampling that won’t double our egress during the canary. We also have SOC 2 evidence windows for ingestion logs (30 days).

Can we please get a proposed list of owners and a first-30-day action plan by EOD? Attaching a short MPA doc that outlines their internal milestones.

Thanks,
Tom
Platform Engineering Manager
Northbridge

Attachments: redwood-implementation-mpa.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

Tom — thanks for the clear brief and the MPA. Proposal below; Ive also attached a one-page kickoff agenda and the shared Google doc for the mutual action plan. High level: we suggest a 3-week initial implementation window focused on tracing + core dashboards, then a 2-week stabilization and runbook creation window.

Owners (recommended):
- Redwood: Ben Carter (traces + sampling), Marissa Cole (dashboards + alert routing), Irene Choi (program manager / SME).
- Northbridge: Tom Nguyen (platform lead), Platform Ops (oncall contact).

Kickoff agenda (30m):
- 00-05m: Introductions & outcomes
- 05-12m: Top flows / telemetry checklist
- 12-20m: Sampling strategy & storage constraints
- 20-28m: Alert taxonomy & runbook triggers (P0/P1/P2)
- 28-30m: Next steps & owners

First-30-days plan (summary):
1) Week 1: Instrumentation — add tracing hooks (header propagation + span naming), initial metrics emitted.
2) Week 2: Dashboards — metrics -> panels for error rate, 95/99 latency, QPS, and anomaly signal.
3) Week 3: Alerts & Runbooks — define alert thresholds, map to team routing, draft runbooks.

Quick asks for you before kickoff:
- Confirm sampling budget (approx % of requests to trace).
- Provide a list of services + repo owners for tracer PRs.

I attached: trace-hook-snippets.md and runbook-trigger-matrix.csv for initial scoping. If that works Ill schedule the 30m kickoff for tomorrow at 11:00 PT.

— Irene

Customer Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Observability commencement action plan — runbooks, alerts, and tracing

Looping in some operational detail based on similar rollouts. A few concrete recommendations so the kickoff is actionable:

- Tracing: Start with 1% head-sampled full traces for scorer and 0.1% for high-volume ingest; add header-based sampling to force-sample specific transactions (saves on egress). Make span names stable (service.operation) and include a correlation_id tag.
- Metrics: emit error_type (categorical) and error_stage (ingest|score|apply) as tags — this feeds the error taxonomy.
- Dashboards: minimum panels: 1) errors per minute by error_type, 2) tail latency (99th) over 5m, 3) request success rate + anomaly baseline, 4) trace volume vs sampling rate.
- Alerts & routing: P0 = production-latency-or-error spike affecting >5% of traffic -> page Platform Ops; P1 = sustained degradation for single region -> page Redwood oncall + Platform Ops; P2 = minor regressions -> email queue.

I attached the trace snippets that map to our auto-instrumentation helpers — they should reduce PR surface area. During the kickoff please get us the exact team emails for routing and the Slack channel for P0 pages.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: trace-hook-snippets.md

Tom — thanks, this looks good and aligns with our internal SLA playbook. Confirming the kickoff tomorrow at 11:00 PT. Final quick commitments from Redwood for the first 30 days:

- Day 0-7: Tracing hooks PRs opened for the three services you listed; 1%/0.1% sampling defaults, with forced sample header option.
- Day 8-14: Dashboards deployed to shared Northbridge Grafana; panels for error taxonomy and tail latency.
- Day 15-21: Alert thresholds enacted with routing to the channel you provide; runbooks drafted and reviewed.
- Day 22-30: Drill / sim exercise (inject a latency spike and an error-rate spike) to validate runbook steps and paging.

Action items for Northbridge before kickoff:
- Provide sampling budget (percent) and team Slack channel for P0 pages.
- Confirm SOC 2 retention window requirement for ingestion logs (we noted 30 days).
- Share repos and owners for tracer changes (link in MPA doc).

Ill put the kickoff on the calendar and send a short invite with the Google doc link. If anything changes, reply-all.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Operations — Redwood Inference
